exposure: Maternal prolonged premature rupture of membranes
cohort: 1444 neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit
finding: The majority of neonatal admissions were term and late preterm infants delivered by cesarean section, with prematurity, respiratory failure, and suspected sepsis due to maternal PROM as leading causes of admission.
mod_finding: The majority of neonatal admissions were delivered by cesarean section.
gest_age: Term and preterm (including late preterm <34-36 6/7 weeks gestation and very low birth weight <1500 grams)
